parameters.name: AllocationId
parameters.description: The ID of the pay-as-you-go EIP.

parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description:
The new maximum bandwidth of the EIP. Valid values:

*   **1** to **200** if the metering method is pay-by-data-transfer. Unit: Mbit/s.
*   **1** to **500** if the metering method is pay-by-bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The new description of the EIP.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and start with a letter. The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The new name of the EIP.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the EIP.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-eip-address-attribute --allocation-id eip-2zeerraiwb7uj6i0d0000 --bandwidth 100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name Test123 --description abc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc ModifyEipAddressAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description abc --AllocationId 'eip-2zeerraiwb7uj6i0d0000' --Bandwidth 100 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name Test123
